prompt: Event candidates are chronological dashcam frames, sampled from a local window plus the true clip start. No reliable vehicle reference is available; use the whole frames. Choose when that collision vehicle FIRST touches the camera car lane boundary with a wheel. Extend the camera car lane through an intersection. A local-window first image may be later than the beginning. True clip first frame is 0; choose it only if already inside at the true beginning. Later reentry is not first entry. Allowed event frames: [0, 10, 20, 30, 41, 51, 61, 71, 81, 91, 101, 111, 122, 132, 142, 152]. Return JSON with entry_frame only, or null if unknown.
